column1: # Login variable table: the server-side variables a character is sent at login.
#   op     the packet the value goes out on (78 = large, 95 = small)
# 1175 rows. These set up the client's interface state - panel positions, tab
# selections, HUD arrangement, filter settings. Without them every variable
# reads 0 and much of the interface will not respond.
# Read by com.opennxt.content.impl.LoginVarps. Sent to every character; a
# character's own stored value wins once it has one.
